result.oq4_recommendation: OQ-4 should be resolved as: mark it. This design's own §2 placement rule and §3 coverage confirmation are explicitly structural/mechanical with no per-file exemption clause -- the convention's entire selling point (§2's justification c, and OQ-3's precedent of marking index-table citations uniformly) is that no citation unit is judgement-called out based on what kind of prose surrounds it. Carving out this design doc itself as 'meta-documentation, not real content' reintroduces exactly the per-citation judgement call §2 was built to eliminate, and sets a precedent that other lib/letflow/design/*.md docs quoting .zig paths in their own worked examples (there may be others besides req237) could also claim exemption, silently shrinking the swept surface. The worked-example citations in §4 are themselves quoted R-Co paths, structurally indistinguishable from any other citation unit in the corpus -- marking them costs nothing (the marker only adds a preceding line, per-file-count and content are otherwise unaffected) and preserves the single, uniform, no-exceptions rule that is this design's core strength. Recommend 239-design-h's owning requirement text instruct marking req237's own worked-example citations like any other unit, and note explicitly that this is not circular (the marker only demotes citation authority framing; it does not alter or remove the marker-defining prose itself).
